coverage: Root month-wide retrieval, separate date-window coverage and topic-specific followups. Distinct mathematically meaningful recovered clusters are developed. The returned material consists of dated retrieval summaries and fragments rather than a complete transcript archive. No unrecovered date is treated as proof that no mathematics occurred.
source_gaps: Full historical transition tables, TTL separator tensors, large intertwiners, support matrices, M22 networks and finite-group census certificates were not returned; small exact models are newly declared examples.
Raw throughput and WIND data were not recovered, so historical timing, prediction accuracy and empirical superiority are not certified.

The asserted general perfect-power classification, complete Thue/cubic census and RH-dependent Schatten thresholds are not adopted as established. Precise tractable subfamilies and conditional analytic scopes replace unsupported global conclusions.
Retrospective query echoes, retrieval-limit statements and a retrieved 2025 file fragment are excluded as original September 2026 mathematics.
new_work_boundary: Every revised question, proof, worked calculation and extension is newly authored. U and A identify the actual role in the exact returned source bullet, not authorship of the revised mathematics. General results are proved in text under stated hypotheses; finite/numerical checks corroborate the specified examples and do not substitute for those proofs.
notable_corrections: For c*n to be a dth power, n=a*t^d where a complements prime valuations of c modulo d; for squares this is the squarefree part of c. The formula n=c*w^2 requires c squarefree or an equivalent restricted parameter convention.
A modular zero-Hom rank proves the rational conclusion only when full column rank is actually certified; exceptional primes can gain solutions.
First-order invisibility does not establish finite-amplitude target constancy on a nonlinear observation fiber.
A simple point certificate on a Mordell curve does not establish the completeness of a curve or Thue census.
